videos.title: Brussels considers allowing restrictions on Ukrainian grain in case of market 'disturbances'

moments.quote: We need to take into account the sensitivities of agricultural sectors, especially in the neighbouring countries... including on a possibility of having safeguards not only in the case of disturbances of the EU market as a whole, but also in case of disturbances of in a single member state or a few member states...
moments.why: L'intervenant de la Commission européenne discute de mesures de sauvegarde pour limiter les importations de céréales ukrainiennes afin de protéger les pays voisins.

videos.title: L'UE dénonce l'interdiction décidée par Varsovie et Budapest d'importer les céréales urkainiennes

moments.quote: La Commission européenne a répondu que ces interdictions unilatérales étaient inacceptables. Elle lance dans l'urgence une consultation... ce qui signifie que c'est au niveau de l'UE que de telles décisions peuvent être prises... Nous avons sur la table une nouvelle proposition pour maintenir cette suspension.
moments.why: La Commission européenne, via sa porte-parole Miriam García Ferrer, expose sa position sur les restrictions unilatérales et ses propositions de suspension des droits de douane.

videos.title: EU moves to limit row over Ukrainian grain as Bulgaria announces import ban

moments.quote: The EU has rushed to quell the revolt arguing for a common European approach as customs policy should be united across the block. You will recall that we have already provided a support package of 56.3 million euros for the most affected farmers - and we are now preparing a second financial support package of 100 million euros.
moments.why: The European Commission spokesperson discusses the EU's response to the unilateral bans by member states and mentions financial support packages for affected farmers.

videos.title: EU blocks Ukraine grain imports to five countries including Poland

moments.quote: The European Union is again extended a ban on Ukrainian grain imports to five countries including Poland.
moments.why: Le journaliste évoque la prolongation par l'Union européenne de l'interdiction d'importation de céréales ukrainiennes vers cinq pays.

moments.quote: Although the decision of the EU supported by the government brings a temporary relief, it was not met with much approval from Polish farmers...
moments.why: Le journaliste mentionne la décision de l'UE d'apporter un soulagement temporaire aux agriculteurs polonais concernant les importations.

videos.title: Trade Commissioner wants full trade liberalization with Ukraine! AGRI Commissioner has no idea!

moments.quote: Now, how have different members of the college contributed to this? Well, they have contributed all of them by looking at the proposals from the college, discussing their point of view. Commission of Wojciechowski was certainly one of them, but he was certainly not the only one.
moments.why: Le porte-parole de la Commission européenne évoque les discussions au sein du collège concernant les propositions relatives à l'Ukraine (incluant les aspects agricoles).

moments.quote: In relation to Commissioner Wojciechowski, he advocates consistently and strongly for European farmers... there's a balance to be struck here between continuing our unwavering support for Ukraine on an economic level, while at the same time listening carefully to the concerns of all relevant stakeholders... any decisions we make including in relation to the extension of the autonomous trade measures will take that evidence into account
moments.why: Il explicite le débat et l'équilibre recherché par la Commission européenne sur les mesures commerciales et l'aide à l'Ukraine en tenant compte de la situation agricole.

videos.title: Brussels proposes to extend EU-Ukraine free trade. But restrictions on grain will be easier to slap

moments.quote: the European Commission has issued proposals to restrict farm imports from Ukraine
moments.why: Le journaliste rapporte que la Commission européenne a émis des propositions pour restreindre les importations agricoles d'Ukraine.

moments.quote: Now the Commission is willing to add an emergency break for other sensitive goods like egg, sugar and poultry. Pre-war tariffs will be introduced if import volumes exceed the level of the last two years.
moments.why: Le journaliste détaille la proposition de la Commission européenne d'introduire des mesures de freinage et des tarifs douaniers sur certains produits.

passages.quote: The European Commission announced "existing measures will expire today" when they run out at midnight.
